confirmed_product_boundaries.side_view_policy: Prefer suitable frontal presentation; only if a concrete solution needs side viewing, justify and validate it per asset and camera domain. User's 15 degrees was an example, not a default.
confirmed_product_boundaries.cheap_geometry_policy: Optional local support with measured visual and cost benefit; not default replacement of scene art. Invisible route/visibility envelopes are not appearance assets.
confirmed_product_boundaries.geometry_escalation_policy: Do not replace unsuccessful 2D assembly with full structural modeling by default; any local geometry support requires a bounded comparison and preserves authored 2D appearance.

scope.numeric_contracts: Freeze measured or explicitly authored inputs in B00; old cave dimensions are not approved defaults.

planned_limits.meaning: Engineering stop limits, not evidence of visual quality or measured optimal budgets.

gates.G0: Protected forest and declared projection domain
gates.G1: Continuous finite route and single shared data source
gates.G2: Actual party and equipment transit without teleporting or speed hacks
gates.G3: Compact cave identity and small portal to interior expansion; visual acceptance required
gates.G4: Valid assemblies, apertures and viewing cones
gates.G5: Semantic coverage under supported cameras and lighting
gates.G6: Layering, repetition control and functional narrative groups
gates.G7: Stable movement, world identities and transitions

tasks.title: 冻结保护基准与测量输入
tasks.done_when: Projection, supported viewports and lighting, actual party transit envelope and evidence provenance are recorded; unknown values are explicit.
tasks.on_failure: Report the exact missing source or measurement; do not reuse rejected cave sizes.

tasks.title: 统一有限侧移路线与接续
tasks.done_when: Five exit cases use arc length and stable local frames, with continuous successors and no unwanted final heading drift.
tasks.on_failure: Return incompatible offset, transition length or swept-domain constraints.

tasks.title: 验证通行队形与门后展开
tasks.done_when: Actual transit fits or required continuous contraction is implemented; equipment sweeps and battle readiness are checked.
tasks.on_failure: Report party versus portal conflict; no hidden teleport or altered locomotion speed.

tasks.title: 定义穿口和恢复镜头许可域
tasks.done_when: Camera state candidates preserve projection and define near-plane and motion constraints for joint solving.
tasks.on_failure: Return infeasible camera state and protected composition constraints; do not change FOV to hide holes.

tasks.title: 资产能力盘点与最小岩组预检
tasks.done_when: Candidate modules have support, inner contour, connector and view capabilities; failed M-shaped pairs are retained as negative cases.
tasks.on_failure: Record precise missing capability. Declared proxy capabilities may support provisional geometry planning but never visual approval.

tasks.title: 联合求解空间镜头与结构
tasks.done_when: A feasible joint template exists inside declared bounds; proxy-based findings are explicitly provisional until B06 revalidation.
tasks.on_failure: Stop dependent generation and return the conflicting constraints within the bounded search limit.

tasks.title: 推导资产需求并补足明确缺口
tasks.done_when: Every requested source has a requirement ID; real assets replace proxies and affected B04/B05 checks are rerun.
tasks.on_failure: Return only incompatible capabilities to B04/B05; do not regenerate the whole library.

tasks.title: 接地与四层稳定撒布
tasks.done_when: Ground regions, support, structure groups, conditional dressing and sparse accents compile with stable IDs and scoped batches.
tasks.on_failure: Attribute failures to support, geometry, recurrence or ownership instead of globally increasing density.

tasks.title: 顶角背景光雾联验
tasks.done_when: Top, sides and upper corners respect semantic closure in formal and supported bright conditions, with stable fog intersections.
tasks.on_failure: Locate invalid view domain, missing module capability or lighting mismatch; no blanket darkness or oversized ceiling.

tasks.title: 连续体验与成本验收包
tasks.done_when: All five processes have reproducible evidence and scoped cost measurements; visual status remains pending until actual review.
tasks.on_failure: Return only the failed gate to its owning task; stop after two repairs without meaningful improvement.

tasks.title: 冻结获认可的首例
tasks.done_when: Required technical gates and user visual acceptance are present with dependency hashes, applicability bounds and unsupported cases.
tasks.on_failure: Keep pending or failed status and explicit issue; do not certify by file existence.

tasks.title: 迁移规则与 Luna 小工单
tasks.done_when: Reusable versus subtype-specific algorithms are separated, I1 extension compatibility is tested, and downstream tasks have concrete inputs, outputs and failure routes.
tasks.on_failure: Expose cave-specific coupling and fix the interface before claiming generality or delegating uncertain design.
